object_description: An unresolved residual for which QUESTION and MEASUREMENT are both plausible responsibility coordinates, together with predeclared question-only and measurement-only interventions under a fixed evaluator/evidence/resource contract.
qoi: Correct responsibility localization and false-reframe harm relative to revising QUESTION or MEASUREMENT without a discriminator.
scope: RFA residuals with QUESTION and MEASUREMENT both plausible
assumptions: question-only and measurement-only interventions are frozen before outcomes
evaluator epoch, evidence cutoff, framework and resource contract are fixed across intervention arms
outcome resolution is judged independently of the intervention author
both-resolve and neither-resolve outcomes do not license a unique responsibility coordinate

strongest_parents.justification: The frozen RFA chain already requires a discriminator whenever multiple responsibility coordinates remain plausible; this mechanic supplies evidence without changing decide().
The strongest internal parent for choosing decision-bearing interventions that separate competing causal/responsibility hypotheses.

oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-world cases inject QUESTION_ONLY, MEASUREMENT_ONLY, BOTH and NEITHER causes. Their exact injected responsibility labels are a conformance oracle. Real residuals without such labels may yield only an identified set or CANNOT_CHECK.
minimal_counterexamples: both question and measurement interventions resolve the residual
neither local intervention resolves the residual
question intervention silently changes available evidence
measurement intervention silently changes the target question
missing arm is interpreted as no effect
falsifier: On fresh known-world cases the discriminator does not reduce wrong-layer revision/false-reframe harm versus fixed immediate-revision parents, or it emits a unique coordinate for BOTH/NEITHER cases.
same_system_ablation: Same residual/evaluator with the discriminator removed: immediately revise QUESTION, immediately revise MEASUREMENT, or choose by a fixed rule.
hard_gate_obligations: BOTH/NEITHER do not collapse to unique cause
total_cost_equation: discriminator_total = probe_design + question_intervention + measurement_intervention + optional_joint_control + evaluation + verification
novelty_residual: An explicit evidence object that lets the existing RFA distinguish QUESTION from MEASUREMENT responsibility without adding a second decision chain or reading QUESTION:0 as a clean bill.
permitted_publication_claim: Only conformance on registered known-world cases until fresh assurance; it never establishes that a real research question is correct.
